title: Knee-to-ankle drive through the press finish
effort: Initiate controlled hip internal rotation and produce a lead-hand rotational pushing release. Grounded knee-to-ankle drive and linear arm presses supply supporting initiation and finishing force.
brief: Open with Seated light-band hip-rotation acceleration as the grounded rotational force anchor. Give the hip internal rotators a small rapid force-expression task without the balance or whole-kick demand.

entries.name: Seated light-band hip-rotation acceleration
entries.sourceDose: 1 × 2 per hip = 4 attempts. Sit with thighs supported, hips/knees near 90 degrees and a very light loop at the lower shins. Rest 20 s between attempts, 60 s between sides/directions, then 90 s before the next entry/section.
